added.review: OpenCV contrib 5.1 adds optional OutputArray colors = noArray() to ColoredKinFu::getCloud (the parser records Mat colors=Mat()[/O]). The old two-output signature is replaced. RGBD/ColoredKinFu has no native wrapper or managed owner; point, normal and color output buffers, KinFu state and sensor inputs remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic runtime evidence.

after.name: cv.colored_kinfu.ColoredKinFu.getCloud

removed.review: Replaced upstream by ColoredKinFu::getCloud(points, normals, colors = noArray()) in 5.1. The old callable was intentionally omitted and had no binding evidence; this signature replacement removes no managed or C ABI member.
